title: Quarterly release lanes and cross-functional orchestration for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Asha Raman
description: Goal: Define a repeatable quarterly process that maps initiatives in the Hosted API and Model Catalog backlog into three release lanes (Fast/Experimental, Stable/Customer-facing, and Ops/Infra) with explicit canary windows, guardrails, and OKR-linked success metrics. Scope covers release lane definitions, cadence, gating criteria (quality, perf, cost), telemetry dashboards to signal rollout readiness, and a cross-team orchestration checklist for PM/Eng/Design/SRE. This ticket will produce: 1) a release-lane decision matrix (owners, rollback criteria, canary durations, capacity reservations), 2) an aligned roadmap calendar for the quarter with milestone owners, and 3) a checklist and dashboard template to be used by Console and Runtime teams for every rollout. Key trade-offs to document: speed of iteration vs. customer stability, which model variants are allowed in Fast lane vs. Stable, and how much Dedicated capacity we proactively reserve for canaries. Outcomes expected: clearer release ownership, fewer emergency rollbacks, and measurable OKR telemetry (latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, model-accuracy regressions on eval suites).
